name: Decision Registry
scope: Index of accepted Ultra Brain architecture and governance decisions.

entities.name: Single Repository Strategy
entities.scope: Keep Ultra Brain governance and separately scoped Meta OS domains in one repository without nested Ultra Brain repositories.

entities.name: Version-Bounded Development
entities.scope: Implement only the approved version while documenting later version boundaries without speculative runtime code.

entities.name: Deferred Official UI and UX
entities.scope: Defer UI and UX implementation until the v0.7-v0.9 sequence after Core Meta OS foundations stabilize.

entities.name: Activate Safety Core Meta OS v0.2
entities.scope: Implement and release the approved v0.2 Safety control plane while preserving the v0.1 Foundation and all excluded domains.

entities.name: Activate Enhancement Core Meta OS v0.3
entities.scope: Implement and release the bounded, evidence-linked, non-executing v0.3 Enhancement assistance plane while preserving Foundation and Safety authority.

entities.name: Activate Automation Core Meta OS v0.4
entities.scope: Implement and release the bounded, Safety-grant-gated, caller-driven v0.4 Automation execution plane while preserving Foundation, Safety, Enhancement, and excluded domains.

entities.name: Activate Collaboration and Connectivity Core Meta OS v0.5
entities.scope: Implement and release the caller-driven, Safety-grant-gated v0.5 exchange plane while preserving the cumulative v0.1-v0.4 baselines and excluded domains.

entities.name: Activate Personal Secretary Core Meta OS v0.6
entities.scope: Implement and release the consent-aware, Safety-grant-gated, caller-data-only v0.6 personal assistance plane while preserving cumulative baselines and excluded domains.

entities.name: Recover Personal Secretary Operational Architecture v0.61
entities.scope: Restore omitted Personal Secretary operational reporting, Database Report, OS Ecosystem, approval, outcome, and failure-support architecture without changing runtime.

entities.name: Integrate Independent OS Ecosystem v0.73
entities.scope: Register and manage OS Ecosystem v0.73 through Ultra Brain v0.7 interfaces, contracts, dependency evidence, operational reporting, and navigation structure without repository merge or ownership transfer.
